metadata.title: कल्पना सोरेन का करिश्मा | Kalpna Soren: Big Factor in Jharkhand Elections
metadata.description: Kalpna Soren entered politics during a challenging time when her husband, Hemant Soren, was in jail. Despite being new to the political arena, she quickly rose to prominence, becoming a star campaigner for her party. Her charisma and ability to connect with the masses made her a key figure in the INDIA alliance's campaign, where she shared the stage with leaders like Rahul Gandhi and others. Now that Hemant Soren is out of jail and leading his party's campaign, Kalpna Soren's popularity remains undiminished. Her growing appeal has created a significant demand for her leadership and presence within the INDIA alliance, underscoring her emergence as a formidable political force.
